title: What types of coffee machines do you repair?
desc: We repair all major types of coffee machines, including automatic, semi-automatic, commercial, and home-use models. Whether it’s a clogged filter, broken pump, or heating issue. We can fix it.

title: How long does a typical repair take?
desc: Most repairs are completed within 24–48 hours, depending on the issue and parts availability. For urgent cases, we also offer same-day service (based on slot availability).

title: Do you offer on-site repair or pickup service?
desc: Yes! We provide both on-site repair for minor issues and free pickup & delivery for more complex repairs, making the process quick and convenient for you.

title: Coffee machine repair near me
desc: Yes! We provide coffee machine repair services in your area. Our expert technicians offer on-site repair, free pickup & delivery, and fast turnaround to get your machine working like new again.Simply book a service online or call us, and we’ll reach your location quickly.

title: How can I book a repair service?
desc: You can easily book your service through our website, WhatsApp, or by calling us directly. Our support team will schedule a convenient time for you.
